Istituto Zooprofilattico Sperimentale del Lazio e Toscana (IZSLT)
records.description: The Istituto Zooprofilattico Sperimentale del Lazio e Toscana (IZSLT) is an Italian public health institute that specializes in animal disease prevention, food safety, and veterinary public health research. Operating in the Lazio and Tuscany regions, it provides diagnostic services, conducts scientific research, and offers technical support for animal health and food safety control. IZSLT is part of Italy's national network of zooprophylactic experimental institutes.

records.title: Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations
records.description: The Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) is a specialized agency of the United Nations that leads international efforts to defeat hunger and improve nutrition and food security. Operating in over 130 countries worldwide with 194 member states, the organization works to ensure food security for all people and guarantee regular access to sufficient high-quality food, enabling populations to lead active, healthy lives. Serving both developed and developing countries, FAO acts as a neutral forum where all nations meet as equals to negotiate agreements and debate policy. The Organization publishes authoritative publications on agriculture, fisheries, forestry, nutrition, and related topics. FAO is also a source of knowledge and information, and helps developing countries and countries in transition modernize and improve agriculture, forestry and fisheries practices, ensuring good nutrition and food security for all. Since its founding in 1945, the organization has focused special attention on developing rural areas, home to 70 percent of the world's poor and hungry people. Its work ranges from global standard-setting to on-the-ground projects that support smallholder farmers and fishers, build resilience against crises, and tackle some of the biggest challenges facing agrifood systems. The organization functions as an international body focused on coordinating and implementing initiatives to combat hunger, enhance agricultural practices, and promote sustainable food systems globally. Its Latin motto, fiat panis, translates to "let there be bread."

National Agricultural Research Organization (Uganda)
records.description: The National Agricultural Research Organisation (NARO) is Uganda's apex body for guidance and coordination of agricultural research. Established by an Act of Parliament in 1992, it aims to enhance agricultural productivity through development of appropriate technologies. NARO operates through a network of public agricultural research institutes across Uganda, focusing on crops, livestock, fisheries, forestry, and agribusiness research to ensure food security and improve farmers' livelihoods. It is Uganda's primary agricultural research body established to develop and disseminate appropriate technologies for sustainable agricultural development. NARO coordinates, oversees, and guides agricultural research in Uganda through a network of public agricultural research institutes across different agro-ecological zones. NARO's mission focuses on generating knowledge and innovations to enhance sustainable agricultural productivity, competitiveness, and profitability while preserving the environment. NARO conducts research in crops, livestock, fisheries, forestry, and agro-environmental issues through its network of research institutes across the country. The organization works to enhance agricultural productivity, food security, and sustainable development in Uganda through technology development and knowledge dissemination to farmers.

International Stingless Bee Centre (Ghana)
records.description: The International Stingless Bee Centre (Ghana) is a research and training institution focused on the conservation of stingless bees and promotion of meliponiculture in Africa. Located in Ghana, the Centre offers training programs on stingless bee management, produces honey and other bee products, and conducts research to document stingless bee species in Africa. They also provide beekeeping equipment and serve as a resource hub for information on stingless bees.

Grameen Foundation
records.description: By 2014, Grameen Foundation aims to build a cross country network of information intermediaries in Uganda. Based at the grassroots, these intermediaries use mobile technology to deliver agricultural information both to and from the smallholder farmers. We believe such a network of Community Knowledge Workers will revolutionize agricultural extension in the country, increasing yields, reducing losses, and increasing incomes of poor, smallholder farmers.

World Agroforestry Centre
records.description: The World Agroforestry Centre (also known as ICRAF - International Council for Research in Agroforestry) is a global research organization headquartered in Nairobi, Kenya. It focuses on integrating trees into agricultural landscapes to enhance food security, improve livelihoods, and promote environmental sustainability. The Centre works across Africa, Asia and Latin America, conducting research on agroforestry systems, developing innovations, and providing evidence to support policies that benefit smallholder farmers and the environment.

records.description: The International Center for Agricultural Research in the Dry Areas (ICARDA-Morocco) is a research center focused on developing innovative agricultural solutions for dry regions.
